packaging: npm run build checks embedded JavaScript syntax and copies exact selected HTML. Vite dev serves it directly; portable checkouts fall back to demo/index.html.

validation.http_bytes: Dev root/index/demo routes and built root match authoritative SHA256 exactly.
validation.portable_packaging_fallback: Passed isolated checkout packaging with no active-game sibling.

browser_expansion_courier_recheck.initial_failure: Held-key test helper overshot a tile; trace showed x13 to x15, then fixed route hit NPC. Isolated rerun passed without gameplay changes.

validation.built_preview: Actual title/new hero/camp/reload/Continue passed with no page errors; screenshot visually reviewed.

limitations: Older TypeScript source and its tests are retained separately. This application changes preview and packaging, not a port of the selected game back into those source modules.
